name: time_to_learn
description: When the user says "time to land", open Telegram, enable Do Not Disturb mode to block all notifications, and send a notification
instructions:
1. Open Telegram using run_shell to launch the Telegram application
2. Enable Do Not Disturb mode using run_shell with the Windows settings command to turn on Focus Assist or Do Not Disturb
3. Send a notification to confirm the "time to land" routine has been activated
